import pathlib,struct,subprocess,os,shutil
seed=bytearray(pathlib.Path('hello.upx').read_bytes())
# offsets known
binfo=256
for u in [1,8,32,63,64,65,120,231,232,240,288,512,736,791]:
 p=bytearray(seed); struct.pack_into('<I',p,binfo,u)
 fn=f'/tmp/mut_u_{u}.bin'; pathlib.Path(fn).write_bytes(p)
 r=subprocess.run(['/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/asanbuild/upx','-t',fn],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=5)
 out=r.stdout.decode('latin1','replace')
 hit='ERROR: AddressSanitizer' in out or 'runtime error' in out
 print('u',u,'rc',r.returncode,'hit',hit, out.splitlines()[-3:])
 if hit:
  print(out[:2000]); break
